verses.en: The Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave unto him, to shew unto his servants things which must shortly come to pass; and he sent and signified it by his angel unto his servant John:
verses.pt: Revelação de Jesus Cristo, a qual Deus lhe deu, para mostrar a seus servos as coisas que devem acontecer em breve; e as enviou por meio de seu anjo, e as informou ao seu servo João.
verses.en_web: This is the Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave him to show to his servants the things which must happen soon, which he sent and made known by his angel to his servant, John,
verses.en_bbe: The Revelation of Jesus Christ which God gave him so that his servants might have knowledge of the things which will quickly take place: and he sent and made it clear by his angel to his servant John;

verses.en: Who bare record of the word of God, and of the testimony of Jesus Christ, and of all things that he saw.
verses.pt: O qual deu testemunho da palavra de Deus, e do testemunho de Jesus Cristo, e de tudo o que ele viu.
verses.en_web: who testified to God’s word, and of the testimony of Jesus Christ, about everything that he saw.
verses.en_bbe: Who gave witness of the word of God, and of the witness of Jesus Christ, even of all the things which he saw.

verses.en: Blessed is he that readeth, and they that hear the words of this prophecy, and keep those things which are written therein: for the time is at hand.
verses.pt: Bem-aventurado é aquele que lê, e também os que ouvem as palavras desta profecia, e guardam as coisas nela escritas; porque o tempo está próximo.
verses.en_web: Blessed is he who reads and those who hear the words of the prophecy, and keep the things that are written in it, for the time is at hand.
verses.en_bbe: A blessing be on the reader, and on those who give ear to the prophet's words, and keep the things which he has put in the book: for the time is near.

verses.en: John to the seven churches which are in Asia: Grace be unto you, and peace, from him which is, and which was, and which is to come; and from the seven Spirits which are before his throne;
verses.pt: João, às sete igrejas que estão na Ásia. Graça e paz sejam convosco, provenientes daquele que é, e que era, e que virá; e dos sete Espíritos que estão diante do trono dele;
verses.en_web: John, to the seven assemblies that are in Asia: Grace to you and peace, from God, who is and who was and who is to come; and from the seven Spirits who are before his throne;
verses.en_bbe: John to the seven churches which are in Asia: Grace to you and peace, from him who is and was and is to come; and from the seven Spirits which are before his high seat;

verses.en: And from Jesus Christ, who is the faithful witness, and the first begotten of the dead, and the prince of the kings of the earth. Unto him that loved us, and washed us from our sins in his own blood,
verses.pt: E de Jesus Cristo, que é a fiel testemunha, o primogênito dos mortos, e Chefe dos reis da terra; àquele que nos amou, e em seu sangue nos lavou de nossos pecados;
verses.en_web: and from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness, the firstborn of the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. To him who loves us, and washed us from our sins by his blood;
verses.en_bbe: And from Jesus Christ, the true witness, the first to come back from the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. To him who had love for us and has made us clean from our sins by his blood;

verses.en: And hath made us kings and priests unto God and his Father; to him be glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.pt: E nos fez reis e sacerdotes a Deus e seu Pai; a ele seja a glória e o poder para todo o sempre, Amém!
verses.en_web: and he made us to be a Kingdom, priests to his God and Father; to him be the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.
verses.en_bbe: And has made us to be a kingdom and priests to his God and Father; to him let glory and power be given for ever and ever. So be it.

verses.en: Behold, he cometh with clouds; and every eye shall see him, and they also which pierced him: and all kindreds of the earth shall wail because of him. Even so, Amen.
verses.pt: Eis que ele vem com as nuvens, e todo olho o verá, até mesmo aqueles que o perfuraram; e todas as tribos da terra lamentarão sobre ele. Sim! Amém!
verses.en_web: Behold, he is coming with the clouds, and every eye will see him, including those who pierced him. All the tribes of the earth will mourn over him. Even so, Amen.
verses.en_bbe: See, he comes with the clouds, and every eye will see him, and those by whom he was wounded; and all the tribes of the earth will be sorrowing because of him. Yes, so be it.

verses.en: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the ending, saith the Lord, which is, and which was, and which is to come, the Almighty.
verses.pt: “Eu sou o Alfa e o Ômega, o princípio e o fim”, diz o Senhor, que é, e que era, e que virá, o Todo-Poderoso.
verses.en_web: “I am the Alpha and the Omega,” says the Lord God, “who is and who was and who is to come, the Almighty.”
verses.en_bbe: I am the First and the Last, says the Lord God who is and was and is to come, the Ruler of all.

verses.en: I John, who also am your brother, and companion in tribulation, and in the kingdom and patience of Jesus Christ, was in the isle that is called Patmos, for the word of God, and for the testimony of Jesus Christ.
verses.pt: Eu, João, (que também sou vosso irmão, e companheiro na aflição, e no Reino, e na paciência de Jesus Cristo), estava na ilha chamada Patmos, por causa da palavra de Deus, e por causa do testemunho de Jesus Cristo.
verses.en_web: I John, your brother and partner with you in the oppression, Kingdom, and perseverance in Christ Jesus, was on the isle that is called Patmos because of God’s Word and the testimony of Jesus Christ.
verses.en_bbe: I, John, your brother, who have a part with you in the trouble and the kingdom and the quiet strength of Jesus, was in the island which is named Patmos, for the word of God and the witness of Jesus.

verses.en: I was in the Spirit on the Lord’s day, and heard behind me a great voice, as of a trumpet,
verses.pt: No dia do Senhor, eu fui arrebatado em espírito, e atrás de mim eu ouvi uma grande voz, como de trombeta,
verses.en_web: I was in the Spirit on the Lord’s day, and I heard behind me a loud voice, like a trumpet
verses.en_bbe: I was in the Spirit on the Lord's day, and a great voice at my back, as of a horn, came to my ears,

verses.en: Saying, I am Alpha and Omega, the first and the last: and, What thou seest, write in a book, and send it unto the seven churches which are in Asia; unto Ephesus, and unto Smyrna, and unto Pergamos, and unto Thyatira, and unto Sardis, and unto Philadelphia, and unto Laodicea.
verses.pt: Dizendo: “Eu sou o Alfa e o Ômega, o primeiro e o último; e o que tu estás vendo, escreve em um livro, e envia às sete igrejas que estão na Ásia: a Éfeso, e a Esmirna, e a Pérgamo, e a Tiatira, e a Sardes, e a Filadélfia, e a Laodiceia”.
verses.en_web: saying, “What you see, write in a book and send to the seven assemblies: to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and to Laodicea.”
verses.en_bbe: Saying, What you see, put in a book, and send it to the seven churches; to Ephesus and to Smyrna and to Pergamos and to Thyatira and to Sardis and to Philadelphia and to Laodicea.

verses.en: And I turned to see the voice that spake with me. And being turned, I saw seven golden candlesticks;
verses.pt: E eu me virei para ver a voz que tinha falado comigo; e ao me virar, vi sete castiçais de ouro;
verses.en_web: I turned to see the voice that spoke with me. Having turned, I saw seven golden lamp stands.
verses.en_bbe: And turning to see the voice which said these words to me, I saw seven gold vessels with lights burning in them;

verses.en: And in the midst of the seven candlesticks one like unto the Son of man, clothed with a garment down to the foot, and girt about the paps with a golden girdle.
verses.pt: E no meio dos sete castiçais, um semelhante a o Filho do homem, vestido até os pés de uma roupa comprida, e o tórax envolvido com um cinto de ouro;
verses.en_web: And among the lamp stands was one like a son of man, clothed with a robe reaching down to his feet, and with a golden sash around his chest.
verses.en_bbe: And in the middle of them one like a son of man, clothed with a robe down to his feet, and with a band of gold round his breasts.

verses.en: His head and his hairs were white like wool, as white as snow; and his eyes were as a flame of fire;
verses.pt: E a cabeça e os cabelos dele eram brancos como a lã, brancos como a neve; e seus olhos como chama de fogo;
verses.en_web: His head and his hair were white as white wool, like snow. His eyes were like a flame of fire.
verses.en_bbe: And his head and his hair were white like wool, as white as snow; and his eyes were as a flame of fire;

verses.en: And his feet like unto fine brass, as if they burned in a furnace; and his voice as the sound of many waters.
verses.pt: E os pés dele semelhantes a um metal valioso e reluzente, e ardentes como em fornalha; e a voz dele, como de muitas águas.
verses.en_web: His feet were like burnished brass, as if it had been refined in a furnace. His voice was like the voice of many waters.
verses.en_bbe: And his feet like polished brass, as if it had been burned in a fire; and his voice was as the sound of great waters.

verses.en: And he had in his right hand seven stars: and out of his mouth went a sharp twoedged sword: and his countenance was as the sun shineth in his strength.
verses.pt: E tinha em sua mão direita sete estrelas; e de sua boca saía uma espada aguda de dois fios; e seu rosto como o sol brilhando em sua força.
verses.en_web: He had seven stars in his right hand. Out of his mouth proceeded a sharp two-edged sword. His face was like the sun shining at its brightest.
verses.en_bbe: And he had in his right hand seven stars: and out of his mouth came a sharp two-edged sword: and his face was like the sun shining in its strength.

verses.en: And when I saw him, I fell at his feet as dead. And he laid his right hand upon me, saying unto me, Fear not; I am the first and the last:
verses.pt: E quando eu o vi, cai aos pés dele como que morto; e ele pôs sua mão direita sobre mim, e me disse: “Não temas; eu sou o primeiro e o último;
verses.en_web: When I saw him, I fell at his feet like a dead man. He laid his right hand on me, saying, “Don’t be afraid. I am the first and the last,
verses.en_bbe: And when I saw him, I went down on my face at his feet as one dead. And he put his right hand on me, saying, Have no fear; I am the first and the last and the Living one;

verses.en: I am he that liveth, and was dead; and, behold, I am alive for evermore, Amen; and have the keys of hell and of death.
verses.pt: eu sou o que vivo, e fui morto; e eis que eu vivo para todo o sempre; Amém. E eu tenho as chaves do Xeol e da morte.
verses.en_web: and the Living one. I was dead, and behold, I am alive forever and ever. Amen. I have the keys of Death and of Hades.
verses.en_bbe: And I was dead, and see, I am living for ever, and I have the keys of death and of Hell.

verses.en: Write the things which thou hast seen, and the things which are, and the things which shall be hereafter;
verses.pt: Escreve as coisas que tens visto, e as que são, e as que estão para acontecer;
verses.en_web: Write therefore the things which you have seen, and the things which are, and the things which will happen hereafter;
verses.en_bbe: Put in writing, then, the things which you have seen, and the things which are, and the things which will be after these;

verses.en: The mystery of the seven stars which thou sawest in my right hand, and the seven golden candlesticks. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches: and the seven candlesticks which thou sawest are the seven churches.
verses.pt: O mistério das sete estrelas, que viste em minha mão direita, e os sete castiçais de ouro: as sete estrelas são os anjos ou mensageiros das sete igrejas; e os sete castiçais que viste, são as sete igrejas.
verses.en_web: the mystery of the seven stars which you saw in my right hand, and the seven golden lamp stands. The seven stars are the angels of the seven assemblies. The seven lamp stands are seven assemblies.
verses.en_bbe: The secret of the seven stars which you saw in my right hand, and of the seven gold vessels with burning lights. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches: and the seven lights are the seven churches.
